verdict.rationale: Brex documents read APIs covering transactions, accounts, statements, expenses, accounting, team, budgets, and travel data, so a user could pull their data programmatically. The only open-format export shown is a Zapier example that sends card transactions to CSV in Google Drive. That makes leaving with your data a build-it-yourself, API- or third-party-driven exercise rather than a first-party capability. Missing for 10: a native one-click or bulk export of all account data, documented open export formats (CSV/JSON) beyond the Zapier recipe, coverage of all data types such as receipts and attachments, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete export works.
